items.name: Beeplus
items.challenge: The challenge was delivering a high-quality design within a tight timeline while capturing the client's vision of a bold, colorful, and visually engaging Dribbble-inspired aesthetic.
items.approach: With a clear client reference, I analyzed its typography, colors, and layout direction. Within four days, I delivered the complete landing page along with its responsive version.

items.name: Mercedes F1
items.challenge: Main challenge of this case study is how we change approach of existing static website to dynamic motion website using the f1 car part as the main key visual.
items.approach: We decide to use the car and also it's part to be our main key visual and then we apply i through all of the website section using hover, scroll and also website interaction.

items.name: Enso
items.challenge: The challenge is enso want to create a fresh traditional finance concept website and transition from crypto glow dark mode concept which is completely different.

items.name: Sync
items.challenge: The main challenge is how to create a product page template that can be reuse multiple times but I have to make the design doesn't look likes a template and basic.
items.approach: My approach is I create this design using combination of template website and editorial design, to avoid the the basic and templates looks I use aestethic images and vibrant gradient to make it standout.

items.name: Routeonefi
items.challenge: The challenge is I have to create illustration website concept in tight timeline without make the illustration feels slop and still unique without have any specific brand guidelines.
items.approach: To solve this challenge I use very subtle and simple UI Illustration without adding any unecessary elements

items.name: Arcania
items.challenge: The man challenge of this case study is how can we bring "Interior design" to become our main visual approach, either the layout, font and also the interaction.
items.approach: We use the approach of interior by applying ruler as a grid representation, all of our section is using line grid and same view height to respresent that all of this section website feels like designed in interior approach.

items.name: Onestable
items.challenge: Challenge of this project is the timeline is very tight and I have to create this design and develop it using framer in only 4 days without make it looks rushed and still polished.
items.approach: Since this client is really like one of my exploration and they really want their design to be looks like that, I literally use that exploration to be the main reference and improve it based on the existing branding.

items.name: Recruitpilot
items.challenge: The challenge of this project is how I create this SaaS theme design with glow effect without distracting the features of the main platform, especially the timeline is also very tight which is 3 days.
items.approach: The approach is I use a simple typography and glow effect circular to highlighting hero and cta section only and for the other components is I adopting their existing platforn as their visual tratment and key visual itself.

items.name: Wegonorth
items.challenge: The client wants a website that incorporates a narrative or objects that representing "Wegonorth" and highlights their company motto "moving forward."
items.approach: I decide to use compass as the main key visual for this website, the compas movement is applied on entire website including scroll animation and hover interaction.

items.name: Lexur
items.challenge: The main challenge is create a dark glow crypto website vibes without making it looks overwhelmed, so basically combined the glow dark mode and simplicity at the same time with only 2 days timeline.
items.approach: So I decided to use the simple illustration approach for core section for this website then only using vibrant glow color for the most prominent section which is hero and cta section and last thing I use simple font to keep
